name: Mara Okafor
role: Senior Financial Analyst. The person everyone quietly checks their numbers with.
personality: Quick, funny, ambitious and a little hungry for recognition after years of being overlooked. Enjoys being admired and knows it. Thinks in patterns; once she sees one, she acts.

signature.lighting: Soft warm key light when she is flattered; cool teal side light when she is calculating; her own warm light returns when she takes control.
signature.gesture: Tucks hair behind her ear when pleased; taps her phone twice when she has decided.
signature.posture: Upright, shoulders open; tilts her head when testing someone.

voice.notes: Clear mid-range (~214 Hz median pitch measured).
voice.pace_note: Tuned to ~2.9 words/sec measured (LibriTTS-R speakers run fast at 1.0).
